compound_impact_analysis.vector: Grease Pencil v3 Geometry Nodes + Vector Streaming
compound_impact_analysis.synthesis: Blender 4.3+ Grease Pencil rewrite shifts 2D stroke primitives to generic curves and point attributes, enabling procedural deformers and real-time SVG geometry node evaluation directly in production viewports.
Segment-Anything (SAM 2) video mask propagation bridges directly with auto-bezier curve fitting engines, reducing per-frame hand rotoscoping hours on animated live-action plates by up to 70%.

executive_brief.title: Grease Pencil v3 Standardizes on ASWF OpenUSD Curves
executive_brief.detail: Major animation studios establish a cross-DCC vector exchange standard converting Grease Pencil stroke layers into USD BasisCurves and stroke attributes.

executive_brief.detail: Diffusion-guided topological morphing preserves stroke thickness and color boundary anchors without line boiling or flickering across complex head turns.
